desc: Ragefire Chasm: the fiery cavern of Ragefire Chasm under Orgrimmar: glowing lava rivers and pools, red-orange rock walls, smoke and embers rising, a rope bridge over the lava
Wailing Caverns: the Wailing Caverns: a huge green cave with glowing mossy roots, misty pools of water, giant mushrooms and vines, soft eerie green light
The Deadmines: the Deadmines: a huge cave with the Defias pirate ship moored in a hidden cove, wooden mine scaffolding and rails, lanterns, crates and barrels of goblin powder
Shadowfang Keep: the courtyard of Shadowfang Keep: dark grey stone castle walls and towers under a stormy night sky with a full moon, torches and gargoyles, creeping mist
Blackfathom Deeps: Blackfathom Deeps: sunken night elf ruins half under dark blue water, broken pillars and arches, glowing blue moonwells, seaweed and shells
The Stockade: the Stormwind Stockade prison: grey stone corridors with iron-barred cells, chains on the walls, flickering torches, straw on the floor
Gnomeregan: Gnomeregan: the gnome city of whirring machinery, huge gears and pipes, steam and leaking green radiation, metal walkways with blinking lights
Razorfen Kraul: Razorfen Kraul: a maze of enormous thorny brambles and vines in the Barrens, quilboar huts and bone totems, dusty orange light
Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard: the Scarlet Monastery graveyard at dusk: crooked tombstones and crypts, dead trees, red Scarlet Crusade banners, ghostly fog and candles
Scarlet Monastery: Library: the Scarlet Monastery library: tall bookshelves full of tomes, red carpets and banners, candelabras and reading desks with open books
Scarlet Monastery: Armory: the Scarlet Monastery armory: racks of swords, shields and armour, red and gold Scarlet Crusade banners, a training yard with dummies
Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral: the Scarlet Monastery cathedral: a grand hall with tall stained-glass windows, red banners, golden candlesticks and pews, warm holy light
Razorfen Downs: Razorfen Downs: thorny bramble mounds overgrown with death, bones and skulls, cold blue frosty light, Scourge-touched quilboar camp
Uldaman: Uldaman: an ancient titan vault of carved stone, huge stone statues of titans and dwarven dig scaffolding, glowing blue runes
Zul'Farrak: Zul'Farrak: a sandy desert troll city with stepped temple pyramids, palm trees, sandstone ruins and tiki torches under a hot sun
Maraudon: Maraudon: a vast cave with glowing purple crystals, a waterfall and lush green ferns and vines, earthy rocks and pools

The Hall of Thanes: the Hall of Thanes: an ancient underground dwarven hall deep inside the mountain, old Ironforge carved from the rock - colossal stone statues of dwarf thanes along the walls, great pillars and arches of carved stone, a huge forge glowing orange, braziers, hanging banners, no sky

Ruins of Lordaeron: the ruins of Lordaeron at dusk: the broken white stone throne room of the fallen human capital open to a dusky purple and orange evening sky, crumbled pillars and arches, dead vines, long shadows and a faint green plague mist
Excavation Site: Wetlands: a dwarven excavation dig site in the misty Wetlands: wooden scaffolding, mine carts, unearthed ancient stones and lanterns in the rain
Sunken Temple: the Sunken Temple of Atal'Hakkar: a troll temple half-sunk in a green swamp lake, dragon statues, vines, glowing green water
Blackrock Depths: Blackrock Depths: the Dark Iron dwarf city deep in the mountain, huge forges, rivers of molten lava, iron bridges and the Grim Guzzler tavern's glow
Lower Blackrock Spire: Lower Blackrock Spire: rough black rock halls of the orc stronghold, spiked banners of the Blackrock clan, fires and lava light
Upper Blackrock Spire: Upper Blackrock Spire: a black dragon's hall with dragon eggs on a rocky perch, black spiked walls, red banners and fire
Dire Maul: East: the east wing of Dire Maul: overgrown night elf ruins in a dark green forest, twisted corrupted trees and glowing purple flowers
Dire Maul: West: the west wing of Dire Maul: an elegant ruined Highborne palace, purple arcane crystals and pylons, broken marble arches
Dire Maul: North: the north wing of Dire Maul: an ogre-held courtyard of broken elven ruins, ogre tents and campfires, a throne of King Gordok
Scholomance: Scholomance: a dark necromancer school in a crypt, bookshelves of forbidden tomes, green candles, bones and a chalk circle on the floor
Stratholme: Live: the living side of Stratholme: a burning human city, red Scarlet banners, cobblestone streets with burning houses and embers in the air
Stratholme: Undead: the undead side of Stratholme: a plague-ruined city, ziggurats and Scourge banners, green plague fog and dead trees under a purple sky
Onyxia's Lair: Onyxia's Lair: a vast dark volcanic cave full of dragon eggs, lava cracks glowing orange, gold and bones scattered on the floor
Barrow Deeps: the Barrow Deeps: the ancient night elf barrows under Mount Hyjal, dark stone tombs with sleeping druids, glowing green and blue runes and roots
Hyjal Summit: the summit of Mount Hyjal: the enormous glowing World Tree Nordrassil towering over snowy pine forests and green aurora light
